parsed.main_gap: A sign error in the lower-inequality expansion makes the displayed derivation invalid as written, although correcting it immediately yields the claimed estimate (5).

errors.description: The expansion should be (t-y)^2+4(t+c)(c-b), not with (b-c). Moreover, the displayed incorrect formula would imply a lower bound on b-c, not the asserted upper bound. With the sign corrected, (5) follows directly, so this is readily repairable.

parsed.notes: Apart from this local sign error, the iterate argument, nonnegativity of the displacement, quadratic estimate, partition argument proving constancy, and verification of all translations C≥0 are correct.
